facts.text: Jon is searching for an ideal location for his dance studio and has found a space with great natural light.

evidence.quote: I'm on the hunt for the ideal spot for my dance studio and it's been quite a journey! I've been looking at different places and picturing how the space would look. I even found a place with great natural light!

facts.text: Jon mentioned visiting Paris the day before the session, which was a significant event for him.

evidence.quote: I've been to Paris yesterday! It was sooo cool.

facts.text: Jon is considering the size and quality of the floor for his dance studio to ensure safety and performance.

evidence.quote: Gotta check the size & floor quality too. We need a good dance floor with enough bounce for me & my students to dance safely.

facts.text: Jon is interested in Marley flooring for his dance studio due to its grip, movement, durability, and ease of cleaning.

evidence.quote: I'm after Marley flooring, which is what dance studios usually use. It's great 'cause it's grippy but still lets you move, plus it's tough and easy to keep clean.
